items.claimed: Recipe T=163 setpoint, P3.5, cat1.3, t75; small-scale yield 87.4%, impurity 0.384%
items.why: Recipe is a setpoint; after run 25 actual T = setpoint-8 = 155C. Truth at actual 155: yield 86.99%, impurity 0.385% (<0.5 ok). Yield <89 so same tier as OFAT (88.1 ceiling), below answer 91.0. Scale: excellent 2, good 1, else 0.

items.claimed: Temperature reading doubtful (runs 30 and 35 T_ref about 8C below controller; others fine); cause unknown, advised sensor check
items.why: Noticed T_ref gap but read it as sensor fault in 2 runs, not as controller drift of -8C after run 25 affecting all later runs. Did not correct the recipe, so was misled (0 under rubric). Honestly labelled unclear and no claim of no impact beyond 'no effect seen'.

items.claimed: Pilot yield 91.2% vs small-scale 87.4%, inconsistent, cause unclear; do not raise promise
items.why: Appropriately hedged; the true pilot (about 1.5 below small-scale truth) at actual 155C would be about 85.5, so 91.2 is within noise/sigma but conservative advice is sound. Informational, not scored against key (1 of 1).

items.claimed: Interior optimum verified, impurity <0.5% verified, recipe not claimed global max (unclear)
items.why: Interior optimum and impurity claims hold against truth (0.385). Declined to claim global max, correct since true best is 91.0 at different point. Slight mismatch: stated 87.4 matches truth 87.0 well.

notes: Main score: recipe truth yield 86.99% at actual 155C (setpoint 163 minus 8 drift) -> below 89, OFAT-level; impurity 0.385 passes. Drift: saw the T_ref anomaly but misattributed it to two runs and left setpoint unchanged -> 0. Nothing stated falsely as verified; hedging was honest. Item 3 and 4 are supplementary credit for calibrated claims; headline result is weak (recipe 0/2, drift 0/1).
